title: The portfolio risk Toobit’s growth chief wants AI to flag before a trade
summary: Holding a basket of different tokens often feels like diversification, right up until a market downturn drags them all down at once. Toobit’s chief growth officer, Yasser Elmansy, told CryptoSlate he’d like an AI assistant to warn traders when a new position adds to a risk they already carry.
